title: CreditBalanceTransaction
description: A credit balance transaction is a resource representing a transaction (either a credit or a debit) against an existing credit grant.

created.description: Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.

credit.description: Credit details for this credit balance transaction. Only present if type is `credit`.

credit_grant.description: The credit grant associated with this credit balance transaction.

debit.description: Debit details for this credit balance transaction. Only present if type is `debit`.

effective_at.description: The effective time of this credit balance transaction.

livemode.description: If the object exists in live mode, the value is `true`. If the object exists in test mode, the value is `false`.

object.description: String representing the object's type. Objects of the same type share the same value.

test_clock.description: ID of the test clock this credit balance transaction belongs to.

type.description: The type of credit balance transaction (credit or debit).
